title: episode.closed payload (v1)
description: Payload of the episode.closed outbox event (ERE-06, #3181, docs/EPISODE_RESOLUTION_ENGINE/EMIT_CLOSURE_AND_DERIVE_DECAY.md). Producer: app.episodes.closure.close_episode, emitted after the Episode note's own time.closed flip (the SoR) is durably written through the guarded seam. This event is plumbing only -- a consumer that misses it self-heals from the episodes projection; nothing in the salience/decay derivation path (app/episodes/closure_decay.py) depends on delivery. context_dimensions (top-level envelope field, SSI-01) is populated from the closed episode note's own frontmatter.
